    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate the hollow square frame (color 5) and the two nonzero markers outside it.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] != 5]
    # Left and right marker colors define the two diagonal pairs of interior quadrants.
    left = min(markers, key=lambda x: x[1])[2]
    right = max(markers, key=lambda x: x[1])[2]
    rm, cm = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            out[r][c] = left if ((r <= rm) == (c <= cm)) else right
    return out
"
